image_motivation: The metaphor of love as conscious gravity is vivid and visual — two nebulae being drawn together transforming into two human figures reaching for each other, the cosmic and intimate scales merged.
image_prompt: Two vast swirling nebulae in deep space slowly pulling toward each other, and where their gas clouds meet and merge, the luminous shape of two human hands reaching for each other forms from the starlight, one hand made of blue gas and one of gold, fingers almost touching, surrounded by newborn stars sparking at the point of contact, dark cosmos behind them.
